phyi mtshan nyid las dngos su bshad pa'i brdar gyur gyi sems thams cad nang rdo rje theg pa la bltos na smon pa tsam du'ang 'gyur te/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas su mngon sum du byed pa'i thabs kyis ma zin pa'o/ des na theg pa de la rgyur bzhag go /theg pa 'di nyid kyi bskyed rim pa man yang smon par rdo rje snying pos gsungs te/ snga ma'i rig pas so/ de tsam du ma zad de bzhin gshegs pa'i dbugs phyung bas sems bskyed pa'ang der 'gyur te/ de kho na nyid du mos pa tsam gyis spyod pas so/ rdo rje 'chang gi dbugs dbyung thob pa nas ni 'jug pa nyid de/ rnam snang mngon byang las/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes 'di ni/ snying rje chen po'i rtsa ba can// byang chub kyi sems kyi rgyu dang ldan pa/ thabs kyis mthar phyin pa'o// zhes so/ rten kun da lta bu ni snying rje'i rtsa ba las brten pa ka ti liṅga kha bye ma thag ltar gsal ba'i mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba chen po bskyed pa ni byang chub tu sems bskyed pa zhes bya ste/ de mngon du byas pa ni sems dpa' dang*/ des spyad pa ni byang chub kyi spyod pa'o// de ltar yang saṃ pu ṭar/ rang gi sems so sor rtog pa'i phyir byang chub kyi sems so/ byang chub tu btab pa'i sems dpa' ni byang chub sems dpa' 'o// de'i spyod pa ni byang chub kyi spyod pa ste/ ji ltar sems dpa' yang dag par rnyed nas rjes su 'brang ba'i phyir rjes su 'gro ba'o zhes so// kun da tsam du bskyed na dbugs dbyung dang po/ gnyis pa ni dbugs dbyung phyi mar 'gyur ro/// bzhi pa la/ tha ma smon pa'i sems bsgom pa/ 'bring 'jug pa'i sems bsgom pa/ rab don dam pa'i sems bsgom pa'o/ dang po ni/ snying rje med na mi 'grub pas// de phyir snying rje yang dag spyad/ rang gi lus rdul phra rab tu bshig /de'ang phyogs char gsil bas lus 'di ma grub par nges pa skye la/

ji ltar rang gi lus de bzhin sems can thams cad dang snod kyi 'jig rten kyang blta'o// khog sbubs lce so rkan mchu sogs ma grub pas de ngag la brten nas 'byung ba'i ngag kyang ma grub/ de ltar lus dang ngag ma grub pas sems kyang ma grub pa zhig ste/ sems ni kha dog tu mi dmigs/ dbyibs su/ phyi nang bar na/ nye ba dang ring bar mi dmigs/ skad cig snga ma ni 'gags/ phyi ma ni ma 'ongs da lta ni mi gnas shing mi zin pa'o/ zhes brtags nas dngos po 'di dag thams cad stong pa nam mkha' dang 'dra ba'i mtshan nyid yin yang*/ de ni sgyu ma dang rmi lam la sogs pa dang 'dra bar thog ma med pa'i dus nas so sor nges pa'i rgyu dang 'bras bu 'brel ba dag la rag las pa'i rgyu des phyin ci log gi rnam par snang ba yin te/ laṅkar gshegs pa las/ chos 'di dag ni ma skyes pa yin te/ sgyu ma smig rgyu dri za'i grong khyer dang*/ rmi lam lta bu sprul dang 'dra ba yin/ zhes gsungs so// sems can rnams ni shes pa ma rig pa'i mun pa shas chen pos khebs pas chos nyid 'di dag khong du ma chud pas yun ring por 'khrul pas rnam par nyams pa yin no// zhes yid la bya zhing snying rje bskyed par bya ba sngon du btang nas/ de nas de'i phyir bdag gi chos nyid 'di dag rang gis kyang rtogs par byas la sems can thams cad kyis kyang khong du chud par bya'o snyam du byang chub kyi sems bsgom mo/// / gal te bde na de la mngon par zhen par mi bya ste/ 'di ni sngar gyi las dge ba zad par byed pa zhes brtags nas/ bdag gi bde ba 'di sems can thams cad gyis thob par gyur cig /ces smon lam gyis sems can gyi tshogs la bsngos nas bdag gir mi bya'o// de bzhin du sdug bsngal na de la skyon du blta bar mi bya ste/ 'di ni sngon bsags bsags pa'i las mi dge ba thams cad 'dag par byed pa'i thabs mchog yin zhes drin du bsgom ste/

sems can sdug bsngal 'di lta bus mnar ba de thams cad kyi sdug bsngal bdag la byung ste bdag gis de thams cad khur nus par gyur cig ces brjod cing*/ yid kyis sems can thams cad kyi sdug bsngal bsgrub par yang yang du de la bstim/ de dag bde ba dang ldan par bsam mo// de phyin nas chos thams cad nam mkha' dang 'dra bar yid la bya ba mi btang bas sems mi dge ba la 'jug par mi byed la/ 'gro ba drang ba'i bsam pa nyid kyis dge ba rnams la yang g.yo ba med la 'khor gsum yongs su dag par bsgrub bo// de'ang 'gro ba ma lus pa byang chub par bya ba'i thabs/ bla na med pa'i byang chub kyi go 'phang yang bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs rdzogs pa med par thob par mi nus/ tshogs gnyis ni pha rol tu phyin pa drug gis bsdus pa yin te/ de'i phyir sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa nas bzung nas thams cad rtag tu yongs su rdzogs par bya/ zhes drug la smon pas dal bur langs te thams cad la sgyu ma dang 'dra bar mos pas ci nus pa'i sbyin sogs la 'jug go /gnyis pa ni/ ji ltar bdag bzhin sems can nyid/ mnyam pa nyid bsgrub pa'i cho ga ste/ ji ltar bdag tu gdags pa'i gzhi phung sogs bden par med pa bzhin du de la bdag tu 'dzin pa'i sems kyang bden par med do// ji ltar sems can de bzhin bdag /bdag tu 'dzin pa'i sems rang bzhin gyis med pa cir yang snang ba bzhin du/ bdag tu gdags pa'i rten phung po rang bzhin med pa cir yang snang ngo zhes ston pa ste bsgom pa'i rim pa 'di ltar/ lus dang*/ ngag dang*/ sems kyis bsdus pa'i chos 'di dag thams cad ni rab tu zhi ba/ spros pa dang bral ba/ nye bar 'tshe ba med pas bde ba dam pa/ rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba nam mkha' dang mnyam pa nyid yin pa mngon du bya'o// de nas sems can 'di dag gi de ltar ma shes pas bdag gis sgyu ma dang 'dra bas de dag gi don bgyi'o zhes bcos ma min pa'i snying rjes sems mnyen par byas la/

rang gis byang chub thob bya'i phyir// gzhan gyi don la brtul bas na// de ni sangs rgyas chos dang ni/ dge 'dun gyi ni bstan par gnas// mngon par byang chub pa'i mnyam par bzhag pa las mi g.yo bar dag pa'i sgyu ma rnam pa thams cad pa bzung nas/ sems can thams cad kyi dgos pa de dang der bdag gi lus sbyin pa dang*/ lus dang*/ ngag dang*/ yid kyis sems can thams cad kyi don 'dzin pa'i tshul khrims dang*/ drag po tsha ba'i sog les gshog pa la sogs pa bzod pa'i bzod pa dang*/ 'jig rten gyi chos brgyad la mnyam pa nyid kyi brtson 'grus dang*/ dngos po thams cad kyi rjes su 'jug pa'i 'bad pa med par rang gi ngang gis 'byung ba'i bsam gtan dang*/ chos thams cad mi dmigs par rjes su rtogs pa'i mtshan nyid kyi shes rab ste/ phyi ma 'di ni 'bad pa med par thams cad du ro gcig pa'i 'jug pas pha rol tu phyin pa thams cad kyi mchog go /dkon mchog gsum gyi bstan pa'i nying khu'ang de'o// chos dbyings rang bzhin du bsgrubs na/ bdag tu 'dzin pa nges par sel// chos thams cad chos kyi dbyings su rnam par dag mthong na bdag gam sems can du 'dzin pa dag nas byang chub kyis spyod pa rdzogs par spyod pa'i lam las phyir mi ldog go /saṃ pu ṭar/ ji ltar byung don yang dag rig /'gro ba 'dod pa'i bsam pa yis/ yang dag lta ba rab bsgyur bdag /brtan pa'i sems ni gnas med pas// phung po khams sogs mtshan nyid ni/ thams cad rmi lam sgyu ma ltar/ khams gsum 'di dag thams cad ni/ mdor bsdus nas ni 'dir shes bya/ sgrib pa kun las rnam par grol/ 'tsho ba dbang phyug 'dul ba dang*/ de bzhin 'jig rten chos brgyad ni// thams cad shin tu ring du spangs// rtag tu rtog pa med gyur pas// gnyis su med par nges byas nas// pha rol phyin drug rnal 'byor gyis// sangs rgyas dngos grub rab bsgrub phyir// sems can don la legs nus kyang*// sems can yongs su brtag mi bya/

zhes spyod pa gsum pa las spros te bshad pas/ jo bo nā ro pas rgyud kyi don legs par bshad do zhes snyigs dus 'dir 'jam dbyangs thob pa rnams sem mo// gsum pa ni/ spros pa med pa'i rang bzhin nyid// shes rab ces ni yongs su bsgrags// yid bzhin nor ltar ma lus pa'i// thams cad don byed snying rje nyid// stong pa nyid dang snying rjes sgrib pa gnyis spangs te/ sku rnam pa gnyis bsgrub par bya'o// ci'i phyir/ stong pa nyid kho nas de dag mi bsgrub ce na/ ma yin te/ 'bras bu ni rgyu'i rjes su 'gro ba'i phyir ro// de ltar gur las/ gal te stong pa thabs yin na// de tshe sangs rgyas nyid mi 'gyur// rgyu las 'bras bu gzhan med phyir// thabs ni stong pa nyid ma yin// 'o na lung gzhan las stong pa nyid 'ba' zhig bsgoms pas chog par gsungs pa don med par 'gyur snyam na ma yin te/ 'di ni bdag tu lta ba la sogs pa nyid dang 'gal bar 'jug pa de dag gi phyir stong pa nyid kyi che ba ston pa ste/ de nyid las/ lta ba rnams las log rnams dang*/ bdag tu lta ba tshol rnams kyi/ bdag tu lta ba bzlog pa'i phyir// rgyal ba rnams kyis stong pa bstan// de phyir dkyil 'khor 'khor lo zhes// thabs ni bde ba'i sdom pa ste/ sangs rgyas nga rgyal rnal 'byor gyis// sangs rgyas nyid yun mi ring 'gyur// zhes rdzogs par byang chub pa la ni stong pa nyid snying rje'i snying po can dgos kyi stong pa nyid kho nas chog pa ma yin no// de yang dang por stong pa nyid la goms pa phul du phyin na dge ba'i las/ thams cad rang gi ngang gis 'byung ste/ ji tsam du stong pa nyid brten pa de la/ de tsam du de ma rtogs pa rnams la snying rje skye ste/ klu sgrub kyi zhal snga nas/ de ltar rnal 'byor pa rnams kyi/ stong nyid 'di ni bsgoms byas na/ blo ni gzhan don la dga' bar/ 'gyur ba nyid du dogs pa med/

ces so/ stong pa nyid ni shes rab kyi mig gis gdod ma'i sems ji lta bar mthong bas/ rnal 'byor pa the tshom dang bral bar 'gyur ro/ the tshom dang bral bas mtshan ma'i mngon par zhen pa dang bral lo// de dang bral nas chos thams cad mtshan ma med par lta ba dang yang bral te nye bar zhi ba 'di ni spros pa med pa'i rang bzhin shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o zhes/ snying rje ni sbyin pa la sogs pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang*/ tshad med pa dang*/ bsdu ba'i dngos po la sogs pa'i dbye bas bya ba/ sems can thams cad la phan pa dang bde ba thams cad byed pa de'o// shes rab ni thabs yang dag par brtags nas phyin ci ma log pas bdag dang gzhan gyi don ji lta ba bzhin byed pa la sbyor bas/ thabs ni bsdu ba shes pa/ shes rab ni yongs su dpyod pa shes par bzhag la bzhag pa ltar tha dad pa ma yin te/ dmigs med gnas su shes rab dang*/ dmigs med snying rje chen po nyid// blo ldan lhan cig gcig gyur pa// nam mkhar nam mkha' ji lta ba/ mtshan ma thams cad zad pas chu la chu'am nam mkha' la nam mkha' sbyar ba lta bur thabs shes dbyer med pa'i ye shes nyid kyis spyod do zhes pa ste/ saṃ pu ṭar/ thabs dang shes rab ldan pa'i mchog /ces snga ma dang*/ sbyor ba kun la rgyab kyis phyogs/ de nyid goms par rab byas pas/ skye ba 'dir ni 'grub par 'gyur// zhes pas phyi ma bstan no// de ltar thabs kyi ni gzugs kyi sku/ zhing dang 'khor la sogs pa'i longs spyod chen po'i 'bras bu phun sum tshogs pa yongs su 'dzin par mdzad pas bcom ldan 'das mya ngan las 'das pa la gnas par mi mdzad do/ shes rab kyis phyin ci log ma lus pa spangs pas 'khor bar gnas par mi mdzad do// 'dir sdug bsngal rgyur bcas kyis rtog pa snying rjer bsgyur bar rnam rtog lam khyer/ shes rab kyis thabs kyi cha thams cad kyi phyin ci log thams cad spangs te grogs su byed pas nyon mongs// nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can gyi khams rjes su 'dzin pas lha 'dre/

de la goms pas gzhan gyi don du dmyal ba'i mi'ang pad+ma'i tshal lta bur shes pas sdug bsngal/ gnod pa thams cad chos kyi dbyings su bzod pas na tsha/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i 'chi 'pho byed pas 'chi ba lam khyer ro/ gnyis pa na tsha lam du khyer ba 'byung ba ro snyoms kyi gdams ngag la/ nad ngos gzung ba/ gsor rung mi rung brtag pa/ nad 'don pa las/ dang po la/ lha 'dre'i nad dang*// rang bzhin gyi nad las/ dang po ni/ lha srin gnod dang*/ nang gi a wa dhū ti ni rigs ldan ma/ de las gyes pa'i rtsa rnams ni pho nya mo yin la/ gzugs dang brnyan po bzhin/ de'i rang snang phyir chad pa lta bur snang ba srid pa'i bdag mo dang*/ de'i mngag gzhug ma srid pa mo rgyud du grags pa thams cad do// dbu ma de kha yig gzugs su snang ba he ru ka /gzhan gyi rnams sems dpa'/ de'i rang snang dpal mgon po dang*/ bka' sdod srid pa pho rgyud du bzhag pa dag ste/ phyi na sde brgyad dam/ dregs pa bco brgyad dam/ sum cu la sogs pa'o// nang gi rigs ldan ma ma mnyes na nang gi he ru ka'ang 'khrug la/ nang gi pho nya mo dang sems dpa' kun g.yo// de'i dbang gis phyir srid pa'i rgyal mo 'khrugs pas mgon po rnams 'khrugs/ sde brgyad pho mo thams cad g.yos te nad brgyad khri bzhi stong 'jig rten du 'gyed do// nang gi rigs ldan ma mi mnyes pa ni phyir rlung 'pho ba/ phyi'i ma mo 'khrugs pa ni dam tshig las g.yel ba'o// dam tshig la gnas pa'i rnal 'byor pa la'ang rtsa rnams dul bar ni 'dod/ dul ni ma dul/ de'i tshe rtsa zugs kyi snang ba lha 'dre'i dmag gi gnod pa dag 'byung la/ de lam du khyer bas bar chad dngos grub tu 'du ba/ chos rje la mkhar chur dpal gyi mgon po lcam dral yang lha 'dre'i dmag dpon/ phyis bdud rigs thams cad 'phrin las bsgrub pa'i chos skyong du shar nas/ bar chad che dus su chos skyong yang dgra ru langs/

da lta bdud kyang dpal du shar zhes dang*/ rje btsun dang tshe rings ma'i lo rgyus/ byang chub kyi shing drung du bdud 'dul ba'i thub pa'i rnam par thar pas kyang shes so/// / gnyis pa la/ 'byung ba 'khrugs pa/ nyon mongs dug gsum/ lus ngag yid gsum/ rnam rtog gi nad las/ dang po ni/ 'byung ba bzhi/ phyi 'jig rten gyi khams/ nang rnal 'byor pa'i lus thams cad ni/ sa chu me rlung gi khams kho nar snang ba ste/ de dag rnam par ma gyur pa ni 'du ba cha snyoms pa/ mnyes pa ni cha mnyam du 'phel bas 'jig rten dang lus dar/ nang zad par la sogs pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyu byed/ ma mnyes na phyi 'jig rten gyi khams kyang rdzogs ldan las gsum ldan/ gnyis ldan rtsod dus/ tha ma tshe lo bcu pa'i bar du 'grib pa dang 'jig pa thams cad dang*/ rnal 'byor pa'i lus/ nyes pa/ rigs/ gnas/ gtso bos phye ba'i nad bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi/ rgyas par phye bas stong nyis brgyar bzhag pa dag dang 'chi ba byed do// ma mnyes pa ni/ 'phel 'khrugs zad dang*/ nyes pa 'phel ba ste gzi brjid 'bar ba/ 'khrugs pa ni rten brten pa 'chol ba/ zad pa ni kha bri ba ste nges so// gnyis pa ni/ tsha grangs dang*/ bad kan 'dus pa nyon mongs nad/ zhe sdang gi rtog pa sum cu rtsa gsum gyis bskyed pa tshad pa/ 'dod chags kyi rtog pa bzhi bcus skyed pa grang ba rlung*/ gti mug gi rtog pa bdun gyis bskyed pa bad kan/ dug gsum cha mnyam pas bskyed pa 'dus pa ste/ dkar dmar mun can dus me'i thig le ma mnyes pa las so// dkar dmar gyi thig le gnyis kyi nges pas nad kyang tsha grang gnyis su 'du/ mun can bsnan/ nad kyang bad kan bsnan pas gsum/ de'i steng du dus me bsnan/ nad kyang 'dus pa bsnan pas bzhi ste/ theg pa lnga/ nad la ldan pa bsnan pas lnga/ thig le drug gi dbang gis gzhan sngar bzhin/ rlung dang grang ba so sor dbye bas drug /de nas nyon mongs pa brgyad khri bzhi stong du phye ba'i bar bzhin nad kyang rnam pa de ltar du 'byed do/// /

gsum pa la/ mdor bstan/ rgyas par bshad pa las/ dang po ni/ sngar gyi gsum ni rtsa rlung thig le rnam par 'gyur ba'i dbang gis nad de dang de dag tu 'gyur tshul yin la/ 'di ni gsum kha'i byed las gyi dbang du byas pa dang*/ sgom pa ting nge 'dzin gyi gegs kho na gtso bor byas pa'o// lus la 'thems 'chus lhags dang gsum 'di ni bsgoms pas rlung zin/ khams 'du ba dang po'i 'go ni brtsams/ rlung zin pa brtan par ma gyur pas mthar ni ma phyin pa'i bar der/ 'thems pa rtsa'i 'phrang*/ 'chus pa rlung gi 'phrang*/ lhags pa thig le'i 'phrang gsum 'byung ba bstan no/ rtsa ma dul ba'i skyon yin pas lus la zhes smros so// ngag la log 'tshubs gtor dang gsum// rlung zin pa brtan pas 'dus pa bar ma'i 'go ni zug /rlung las su ma rung bas mthar ni ma phyin pa'i bar der// rlung gi de kho na nyid gsum su log pa'i 'phrang*/ 'tshubs pa'i 'phrang*/ gtor ba'i 'phrang gsum 'byung la/ de dag rlung ma dul ba'i skyon yin pas ngag la zhes so// yid la 'byams 'dus ltengs dang gsum/ de nas rlung las su ni rung bas 'dus pa tha ma'i 'go zug /ting nge'i dzin las su ma rung bas mthar ni ma phyin pa'i bar der/ gsal ba la 'byams pa'i 'phrang*/ bde ba la 'dus pa'i 'phrang*/ mi rtog pa la ltengs pa'i 'phrang gsum 'byung ste/ ting nge 'dzin gyi dug yin pas yid zhes so// dgu po'i 'phrang la ma brdugs na// sgom skyon 'byung bar 'gyur ma yin// zhes 'phrang de dag sgrol na ting nge 'dzin khyad par can du 'gyur bas/ phyis gegs mi 'byung bas gegs sel mi dgos zhes pa'i don no// gnyis pa la/ 'thams pa/ 'chus pa/ lhags pa/ log pa/ 'tshubs pa/ gtor ba/ 'byams pa/ 'dus pa/ ltengs pa bshad pa las/ dang po ni/ 'thems pa sha rus thams pa ste// chu ser tshad pa 'phel bar 'gyur// rlung zin pas phyir 'pho rgyu ma byung*// drod btsan thabs su skyes pas rtsa kha 'ga' zhig phye/

de dag tu rlung des 'tshangs pas/ sha dang rus pa'i bar dang*/ sha dang pags pa'i bar du song*/ de nas phugs brdugs te gzhan du ma rtol bas/ lus ril po'am/ gzhogs phyed dam/ stod smad gang rung ngam/ khol bur na ba/ tsha 'khyug byed pa/ sbrid cing bems pa/ lgang bug chus btab pa ltar gyur na 'phral du ma bcos na chu ser 'phel te nad du 'gyur ro// rtsa thams rlung khrag byang chub sems/ rgyu ba'i lam chad 'dzag pa'ang 'byung*// rtsa'i gnas 'ga' zhig tu rlung gi phyin pas rlung ngam/ khrag gam/ byang chub kyi sems 'bab pa bcer bas rgyu ba'i lam khrag gis 'gags nas/ der rlung la sogs pa de dag nad du 'gyur ba dang*/ yang lam gsum po de dag kha bye nas dbang med du 'dzag pa'ang 'byung bas ma bcos na nad du 'gyur ro/// / gnyis pa ni/ 'chus pa de dang cha mthun te/ 'on kyang 'phral la bsal bar 'gyur/ lte ba yan steng rlung*/ man chad 'og rlung*/ bsgoms pas steng rlung thams cad snying gar srog 'dzin pa'i rlung gis dbang du bsdus nas gyen du 'dren pa'i rlung stobs nyams 'og rlung stobs 'phel te steng rlung thams cad 'og tu 'chus/ 'phral la pho smad rkyal pa chus btab pa bzhin song nas dri chen dri chung bsdam pa dang*/ sbo ba dang*/ 'og rlung mi thon pa dang*/ des stod du gzer chung 'ong*/ nyin zhag gis tshe'i dus byed/ yang srog 'dzin gyi rlung des 'og rlung thams cad dbang du bsdus/ 'og stobs nyams gyen du 'dren pa stobs 'phel te/ 'og rlung srog dang bsdongs te gyen du 'tshangs pas 'phral la rlung phyir gtong ma shes/ nang du sdus mi tshugs/ des ro stod gzer ba dang*/ brgyangs nas na ba 'byung*/ nyin zhag gcig gis 'chi bar byed pa'o// gsum pa ni/ lhags pa chu ser skya rbab sogs/ yun ring lus na mdze ru 'gyur// lhags pa ni/ byang sems 'dzag pa zhes bya ste/ bde ba rgyas pa dang*/ nad gdon/ rtsa kha bye ba/

zas/ chags pa/ bag chags/ spyod lam/ grib stobs kyis 'dzag pa'o// ma bcos na lus kyi shed shor/ chu ser 'phel/ skya rbab dang*/ 'or dang*/ dmu chu dang*/ mdze la sogs par 'gyur ro// gzhan yang*/ lba ba la sogs bem por ro/ khol bur lhags pas lba ba dang*/ skrangs pa dang*/ sha nag po bam bem dang*/ ha cang rgyas drags nas sha 'phel te gas pa'o// bzhi pa ni/ srog 'dzin rlung ni snying la gnas// las su bdag 'dzin dran rtog skyed// log na 'dar dang smyo sogs 'byung*// rlung bcu re re la bdun bdun te/ gnas gang na gnas pa/ ming gang yin pa/ 'byung ba lnga gang gi rlung yin pa/ byed pa'i las ci byed pa/ rlung rengs pa'i skyon ngos gzung ba/ skyon de bsal ba'i thabs/ ye shes su 'char na gang 'char ba'o// dang po srog 'dzin gnas snying ga /ming srog 'dzin/ 'byung ba chu/ bdag 'dzin dang dran rtog skyed/ gnas su log pa'i skyon/ 'phyo zhing mi dga' ba/ gzer zhing zug pa/ dgang zhing stong pa/ bying zhing rmugs pa'o// 'chos pa dang ting nge 'dzin 'og tu 'chad do// de bzhin/ me dang mnyam pa lte bar gnas/ kha zas 'ju zhing dwangs snyigs 'byed// log na sbo zhing 'khrog dang 'khru/ gnas lte ba/ ming me mnyam/ rlung gi rlung*/ las kha zas 'ju/ dwangs snyigs 'byed/ log na dgangs pa/ 'grim pa/ gzer ba/ khong pa 'byams pa'o// thur du sel ba gsang bar gnas// sgo gnyis sdom dang 'phen par byed/ log na dri gnyis sdom dang 'chor// gnas gsang gnas/ ming thur sel/ 'byung ba sa/ las 'og tu sdom 'phen/ log na dri chen dri chu 'og gi rlung bsdam pa dang*/ dbang med dri gnyis 'chor ba'o// gyen du rgyu ba mgrin par gnas/ smra brjod las kun byed par 'gyur// log na mgrin pa skrangs dang dig /gnas mgrin pa/ ming gyen rgyu/ 'byung ba me/ las smra brjod gyen du 'dren pa/ log na mjing pa skrangs pa sogs kyi nad/ skad 'gag pa dang ngag dig pa'o// khyab byed lus kyi tshigs la gnas/

las ni yan lag sgul skyod byed/ log na tshigs ba zhi na bar 'gyur// gnas lus thams cad du/ ming khyab byed 'byung ba nam mkha' las lus kyi bya ba'i gnas skabs thams cad/ log na tshigs na la/ lus byin nam/ phyogs re'am/ stod smad na ba/ zha 'khums thams cad do// rtsa ba'i rlung lnga bshad nas/ da ni yan lag gi rlung ston te/ rgyu ba mig gis gzugs mthong byed/ gnas mig ming rgyu ba/ 'byung ba chu me gnyis 'dres/ las gzugs lta ba/ log na long ba sogs mig nad/ rab tu rgyu ba rna ba'i sgra/ gnas rna ba/ ming rab tu rgyu ba/ 'byung ba nam mkha' ye shes gnyis 'dres/ las sgra thos pa/ log na 'on pa la sogs pa rna ba'i nad/ de bzhin du/ shin tu rgyu ba sna yi dri/ gnas sna/ ming shin tu rgyu ba/ 'byung ba sa rlung gnyis 'dres/ las dri snom pa/ log na sna zhom pa sogs sna'i nad/ mngon par rgyu ba lce yi ro// gnas lce/ ming mngon par rgyu ba/ 'byung ba me chu gnyis 'dre/ las ro myang*/ log na lce chad pa sogs lce'i nad/ yang dag rgyu ba pags pa yi/ reg bya nyams su myong bar byed/ gnas lus kyi pags pa/ ming yang dag par rgyu ba/ 'byung ba rlung sa gnyis 'dres pa las reg bya tshor ba/ log na lus bem pa za phrug la sogs so// 'di rnams gnas su log gyur na// yul lnga rnam pa sna tshogs 'byung*// log pa'i skyon gzugs gcig gnyis su snang ba lta bu sogs 'byung zhes so// 'di dag rang gi gnas su log pa la bshad pa yin la/ snga ma ni gnas gzhan du 'phyugs pa yin pas khyad par che'o// lnga pa ni/ stod du 'tshubs na mgo bo na// smad du 'tshubs na rgyu long khrog /bar du 'tshubs na ro rgyab gzer// 'di ni rlung 'gro sa ma rnyed pas stod du 'khyims nas stod nad/ smad du smad nad/ bar du 'khyims pas bar nad thams cad byed do// don rtsa kha ma bye bas sam/ lus gnad kyis bsdams pas sam/ khrag la sogs pa 'gags pas so// drug pa ni/

skyon yon ci yang ma byung na// gtor bar yin pas btsal bar bya// 'di ni rlung bya 'das pa ste dbyung rdub byed ma shes pa'o// gzhan lus thams cad du 'thor ba'ang yin te/ de ni yun ring na skya rbab la sogs par 'gyur ro// bdun pa ni/ rtsa dang rlung gi bye brag gis/ rtsa'i mdud pa dang rlung gi khyad par gyis/ rlung sems drod gsum 'dus pa'i nyams skyon can sna tshogs par 'gyur ba ni/ la las brgyal zhing 'gyel bar 'gyur/ la las skyug cing 'khru bar 'gyur/ la las sdug bsngal mya ngan skye/ la las skrag cing dngangs par 'gyur/ zhes dang*/ sangs rgyas zhing dang*/ skyon med sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams mthong ba sogs mthong snang ngo mtshar can ci yang 'byung ngo*// dmyal ba'i gnas/ mthong snang dpag tu med pa 'byung*// dmyal ba'i rtsa yig duḥbashang lam na gnas/ 'ga' zhig la rkang mthil du'ang srid/ der rlung sems drod gsum 'dus pas dmyal ba'i snang ba 'char/ yi dwags kyi pre chu lam/ dud 'gro'i tri lte ba na/ mi'i nri snying ga na/ lha ma yin gyi su smin 'og gi mtshams/ lha'i rtsa yig a dpral ba na gnas shing*/ de dag tu rlung sems drod gsum 'dus pas so so'i gnas grogs longs spyod 'char ro/ gzhan yang*/ rgod cing ku co 'don pa dang*/ lkugs shing yan lag rengs pa dang*// khol bur sha phrig la sogs 'byung*// kun gyi bye brag shes bya ste// gegs sel gnad du bsnun par bya// zhes pa rnams ni gsal ba la 'byams pa'am brdugs pa zhes bya ste/ 'byams pa ri gzar chu 'bab 'dra// sna tshogs yul la 'thor ba yin// ting nge 'dzin de la 'byams sam brdugs na rtags bcu yon tan brgyad 'grib bo// brgyad pa ni/ 'du ba bya rnyis zin pa 'dra/ rtsa kha bye bas byang sems 'phel// zag bcas kyi bde ba rgyas drags pas brdabs pa/ tsher ma zug pa sogs kyang bde bar song*/ ting nge 'dzin yang dran med lta bu khris su mi sleb pa mi tshor/

dper na ri mgo rmugs pas g.yogs pa lta bu'o// 'dar dang 'phar dang du sogs 'byung*// zhes pa ni ding sang gi sbyor drug pa dag nyams 'phar ba de ji lta ba'o// dgu pa ni/ ltengs pa ko ma'i chu dang 'dra// sems kyi dwangs snyigs ma phyed pas// mi gsal rmugs pa'i rang bzhin can// 'dir bying ba ni gnyis te/ chung ngu chen po'o// dang po ni/ lus lci zhing mi theg la/ sems nyams su shes pa log pa bying ba/ ting nge 'dzin mi gsal ba rmugs pa'o// chen po ni/ de'ang lus 'di la rlung khrag byang sems mi rgyu ba'i rtsa 'ga' zhig yod la/ der rlung zhugs pas 'gog pa'i snyoms 'jug bzhin dran med du 'gro/ de ni bying ba chen po'i 'phrang zhes bya'o// de'i dus su lus la reg tu mi btub srog gi bar chad du 'gro nyen yod gsung ngo*// rtsa rlung sgom pa'i log rnams ni// phal cher lus gnad rlung las byung*// rtsa rlung gi gegs phal che ba lus gnad bca' ma legs pa dang*/ rlung sgom pa ma legs pa las 'byung ngo*// zhi gnas log ni sems las so// zhi gnas kyi skyon rnams ni dran shes skyon can gyis sems las 'byung ngo*/ rang bzhin log rnams rkyen res slong*// sgom pas ma yin par 'byung ba ni rang bzhin zhes bya la/ de ni 'phral gyi rkyen gyis bslangs pa'o// skyon rnams ngo yis ma zin na// log gnod bye brag dpag med kyang*// mun pa'i 'ben la 'da' 'phen 'dra// nad ngos ma zin par 'chos thabs ci shes kyang thog tu mi khel bas don med ces pa'o// lus skyon dmigs pas 'chos pa ni// mgo chag rkang pa 'ching dang mtshungs// lus gnad ma legs pas 'byung ba lta bu dmigs pas ci bcos kyang phan mi thogs/ lus gnad bcos pas de nyid du zhi 'gro'o// rtsa rlung dmigs pa de dang 'dra/ rtsa'i gnad shes pas 'chos rgyu rlung gir 'khrul nas bcos pa lta bus mi phan no// de bas mig dang 'dra ba yi// man ngag snying gi dkyil du bcang*// brtag thabs kyi man ngag ni mig lta bur shes par bya'o/

bzhi pa rnam rtog gi gnad ni/ 'dus pa tha ma rdzogs nas thams cad rnam par rtog pa tsam du shes pa de'i phyir// rnam rtog nad ni glo ba// zhes so// gnyis pa gsor rung mi rung brtag pa ni/ mi rung ba gang zhe na/ pags bzhi sa la lhung ba dang*// sha zad rus la gtugs pa dang*// zas la zhen pa log pa dang*// ldang 'dug med par na ba dang*/ mtshon cha gnad du phog pa dang*// shes pa gnas nas 'khyar ba ste// drugag po 'di dag mkhas pas spang*// zhes sam/ 'bras bu srog gcod pa'i nad dgu zhes gso dpyad pa 'dod pa dag go /bcos su btub pa gang zhe na/ bla ma la gus gtong phod che// lus stobs brtan zhing snying rus che// dmigs pa rno zhing nyams len bzang*// mi mthun phyogs rnams rgyan du shar// de ni blo gros can gyis bsten// gzhan gyi 'don pa'am/ rang nyid la 'dis nad 'chos na mtshan nyid de dag ldan pa la bya'o/// / gsum pa nad 'don pa la/ spyi'i nad 'don/ bye brag so so'i nad 'don/ nad 'don gyi mjug bsdu ba gsum las/ dang po la/ rab lta bas/ 'bring sgom pas/ tha ma 'khrul 'khor gyis 'don pa las/ dang po la/ sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi las/ dang po la/ lung bstan pa dang*/ mtshams sbyar ba las/ dang po ni/ mi brjed gzungs thob nā ro pas// bcu gnyis bar du nga bsten byas// nga yi rtogs pa kho la yod// phyi rabs sems can don gnyer rnams// rtogs par 'dod na kho la thug /'di ni slob dpon til+li pas nā ro pa la/ ji ltar rnam par snang mdzad kyis byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po la skye ba brgyud mar gzhan gyi don byed par byin gyis brlabs pa lta bu'o zhes shes par byed pa'o// de lta bu'i slob dpon de la de ltar byin gyis rlob pa'i mthu yod dam zhe na/ yod de/ ngas ni zhing khams brgyar yang phyin// sprul pa brgya phrag brgya yang bstan// tsār+ya klu sgrub lwa ba pa// sangs rgyas dang yang ngas gtam byas// slob dpon nyid kyis de ltar zhal gyis bzhes pa ni khengs pa skyung ba ste/

don la bcom ldan 'das nyid du grags pas so/ gnyis pa ni/ bca' ba lus kyi 'khrul 'khor dang*// srog rtsol rlung gi byed pa dang*// dmigs pa yid kyi ting nge 'dzin gsum// rnal 'byor pa yis gzung bar bya// dmigs pa rlung 'khrul 'khor gsum phrugs su gyur nas 'don pa shas che bas de skad du gsungs so/// / gnyis pa la/ mdor bstan/ rgyas par bshad pa las/ dang po ni/ rtogs ldan rnams ni lta bas te// dmigs pa rnon po sgom pa yin// rtsol bsgrub drag po'i 'khrul 'khor gyis// sbyor ba 'joms par byed pa yin// 'o na thams cad la gsum phrugs su dgos sam zhe na mi dgos te/ dbang po rnon po 'dus pa gsum pa mthar phyin pa de la lta bas chog /'bring 'dus pa gnyis pa la gnas pa de la sgom pas// dbang po tha ma tshogs kyi sa la bzhugs pa tsam la gsum ka dgos zhes rnam par phye ste bshad do// gnyis pa la/ dang por rtog pa ngos gzung*/ bar du bdag 'dzin blos btang*/ tha ma re dogs kyi 'phrang bsal ba las/ dang po la/ ci dgu rtog par thag bcad/ rtog pa'i rang bzhin chos skur bstan/ chos sku'i ngang nas 'khor 'das 'byung ba'i dpe bstan/ 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal nyams su blang ba'o// dang po ni/ nad dang gdon gyi bar chad kyang*// bsdu na rnam par rtog par 'dus/ nad gdon thams cad mi bden pa zhig la rtog pas zhen zhugs byas pas/ na na'ang rtog pa de nyid na// gnod na'ang rtog pa de nyid gnod// 'chi na'ang rtog pa de nyid 'chi// skye na'ang rtog pa de nyid skye// thams cad rnam par rtog pa ste// nad gdon skye 'chi thams cad bden pa ltar du thob bo// gnyis pa ni/ sems la ci yang yod ma yin// ji ltar rtog pas thob pa de ltar sems kyi ngo bo'i gshis sam gdangs ma bcos pa la yod pa min pas/ 'di dag gi rang bzhin dag pa'o// rtog pa'i gzhi rtsa chod gyur na// nad gdon 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro// rtog par bzhag pa la bzhag pa ltar ma grub par so so rang rig gis mthong na rtog pa'i rang bzhin shes pa zhes bya la/

de nas snang ba chos sku'i rgya yan zhes bya ba de 'byung ngo*/ gsum pa ni/ sangs rgyas che ba'i yon tan dang*// 'khor ba sdug bsngal rang bzhin gnyis// rtog pa'i ngo bor gcig pa ste// dper na nam mkha'i sprin bzhin no// dri ma med pa'i gnas skabs yon tan gyis brgyan pa dang*/ dri ma dang bcas pa'i gnas skabs su skyon gyi phung por snang ba gnyis ka'ang nam mkha' sprin med dang sprin bcas bzhin rtog ngor yin te/ don la rang bzhin de dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas kyis kyang gzigs par ma gyur na/ dri ma dang bcas ma bcas su gzhog sus nus/ ri bong gi rwa'i rno ngar lta bu'o// bzhi pa la/ na tsha byung na phyi'i rkyen la mi ltos par bstan/ nad 'don gyi rtsa ba bla ma'i mos gus su bstan/ gdam ngag la yid ches pas ltem kyang med par nyams su blang bar bstan pa'i/ dang po ni/ yon tan nyid kyang yal gyur na// sdug bsngal rtog pa su zhig len// yon tan te gnyen po rnam par byang ba rnams kyang sgyu ma lta bur mi bden par yal ba la/ spang bya sdug bsngal gyis bsdus pa 'khor ba'i chos thams cad la bden par su zhig lta zhes brtags nas/ de bas rang bzhin shes pa yis// blang dor med par spyad par bya// de bas 'ga' zhig ni spang la 'ga' zhig ni bsgrub par byar ci zhig yod de med pas mnyam pa nyid du spyad par bya'o// de bas na/ nad la sman pa mi 'gugs shing*// gdon la rim gro mi bya ste// gzhan gyis phan pa'i sems spangs la// 'jig rten mi dang blo mi bstun// 'jig rten dngos po yang dag pa nyid du rtog pa dang blo mi bstun te nad rmi lam gyi snang ba tsam du lam du khyer ba'o// gnyis pa ni/ rgyun chad med par gsol ba gdab// chos thams cad sgyu ma lta bu yin pas bla ma phyir ma lus rang sems nang du ma lus pas gnyis su med par nges pa'i gsol ba btab bo/ 'di ni lam thams cad kyi rtsa ba yin no// gsum pa ni/

stems rkyang med par nyams su blang*/ steng shod med par ro// khu 'khrig med par brtan pa'i blos// phan nam mi phan nam snyam pa khu 'khrig ste de med pa'o// re dogs thag pa gcad par bya// phan du mi re/ mi phan dogs mi bya'o// gnyis pa bar du bdag 'dzin blos gtang ba la/ sdug bsngal thams cad kyi rtsa ba ngos bzung*/ de gnyen pos nyam su blang ba'o// dang po ni/ kun gyi rtsa ba 'dzin pa ste// gang la zhen pa yod na de ni 'ching bar 'gyur ba chos nyid yin pas 'dzin pa'am zhen pa bya ba de 'dus byas sam 'dus ma byas pa'i 'khor ba thams cad kyi rtsa ba'o/// / gnyis pa la/ gnas lugs nyams su blang ba dang*// rtog chos nyams su blang ba'o// dang po la/ lta ba gtan la phab/ sgom pas lus sems phral la gzhag /de'i 'bras bu rang sar grol ba/ lta sgom gcig tu dril nas spros bcas kyi spyod ba bya bar bstan pa'o// dang po ni/ 'dzin pa med na sa rdo dang*// nam mkha' lta bu gnas pa la// kun rdzob rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba mi dgag la/ mthar thug ci la'ang mi gnas pas nam mkha' lta bur shes par bya'o// gnyis pa ni/ na ba gang yin bde ba gang*// gang yang yid la mi bya bar// lam khar bor ba'i ro bzhin du// lus kyi bdag 'dzin bor byas la// 'dzin med nam mkha'i ngang la gzhag /sems kyis sems la mi lta bar gnyug ma lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes kyi ngang du rang lugs gzhag pa'o// de nyid bdag 'dzin blos gtong ba yin la/ gzhan bdag 'khor bar bskyur mkhan bdag 'dzin du 'dug la/ de spang dgos snyam zhe gnag brnag pas de blos thongs par mi 'dug go /gsum pa ni/ de ltar bdag 'dzin bor byas pas// rtog pa mkha' ltar dag gyur te/ nad dang nad pa gdon dang gsum// nam mkha' lta bur byin lobs na// rang sar grol ba the tshom med// de ltar bzhag pas rtsa dwangs/ rtsa dwangs pas rlung dwangs/ rlung dwangs pas byang chub kyi sems dwangs/

byang sems dwangs pas bde stong gnyis su med pa'i ye shes ngang gis gsal te// de'i ngang du rtsa zug rlung zug thig le'i zug sogs nad dang nad pa gdon thams cad rang zhi rang dag tu 'gro ba ni 'bras bu'o// bzhi pa ni/ res 'ga' nam mkha' 'ja' tshon 'dra// gzugs sku'i rang bzhin shes bya la// thogs med rdo rje lta bu'i sku// mkha' dang mnyam pa'i zhing khams dgang*// de ltar bdag byin gyis rlobs na/ stong pa nyid de'i ngang du sgyu ma'i dpe bcu drug gam bcu gnyis kyis mtshon pa'i lha'i sku rnam pa thams cad pa'i mchog dang ldan pa de shar du bcug la/ de'i dbyings su rig bya rig byed gnyis med du ro mnyam zhing*/ 'di la goms nas bdag gi lus dang stong gzugs de bsre zhing lus kyang 'ja' tshon 'dra ba der song na phyi'i snang ba thams cad kyi tshugs mi thub par sbyangs nas sgyu ma lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin du 'byams sla'o// mkha' la grags pa'i brag cha ltar// sgra yi rang bzhin shes bya la/ gsang sngags rdo rje'i 'brug sgra dang*// 'od kyi nam mkha' dgang bar bya// de tsa na phyi nang gi rlung thams cad srog gi gzugs su grub pas sgra thams cad brjod du med la brjod pa thams cad kyi rgyur song ba'i phyir dang*// rnal 'byor pa'i lus kyang nyi ma 'jas bskor rang bzhin 'od zer lnga'i khyim du tshud pa gsal stong*/ dpa' bar 'gro ba'i ting nge 'dzin du seṅge rnam par rtse ba ston no// rtogs pa lta ba'i gdengs tshad dang*// bskyed rim lha yi nga rgyal dang*// brjod pa sngags kyi nus pa yis// rig pa'i brtul zhugs skyed par byed// gshis gnyis su med pa'i ye shes ni rdzogs rim gdangs 'gag pa med pa'i 'char sgo'i snang ba ni bskyed rim gyi lha/ grags pa ni sngags kyi sgra de dag gnyis su med cing gnyis su byar med pa'i nyams myong du ro gcig pa rig pa'i brtul zhugs zhes bya ste/

bde stong rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin gyis g.yul du bdud bzhi'i dpung rmig med du 'joms so// gnyis pa rtog chos nyams su blang ba la/ so sor rtog pa'i shes rab kyis nad yang dang yang du stong pa nyid du lta ba/ nad gdon gyi gnyen por rtog pa glo bur bas thog brdzis btang ba/ don bsdus te nyams su blang ba las/ dang po ni/ nad dang gdon gyi dngos po de// gang las byung zhing gang la 'don// gang du 'gro ba blta byas la// ma rnyed pa dang ngang la bzhag /yang cig ldang bar bzo ba dang*// da dung gzhi rtsa gcad par bya// sngar ma rnyed pa'i nad dang gdon// phyis nas 'byung bar ga la 'gyur// na ba'am gdon gdon na nad dam gdon de rgyu gang la skyes// gar gnas/ gar 'gag so sor rtog pa'i shes rab kyis mtshan ma med pa'i zhi gnas kyi klong du brtags pas nad dang gdon gyi dngos po ma rnyed la/ dngos po med par dngos med 'jog mi shes pas nye bar zhi bar 'gyur la/ de ka'i ngang du 'bol le shig ge gzhag go /gal te nad ldang bar bzon na ba'i mkhan po rtsad dpyad pas sngar bzhin du bya'o// grub chen gling gis/ na tsha sems kyi me long yin// na mkhan 'dug gam mi 'dug ltos// ji srid sems la gnod kyi bar// da dung na mkhan gyi rig pa tshol// zhes so// gnyis pa ni/ des kyang ma bde ldang gyur na// bzlog pa sman du btang bar bya// de lta bur so sor rtog pa'i shes rab kyis nad gzhi med du rtsal ma sbyongs na/ bzlog sgom gyi gnad la 'bor te/ ji ltar rlung nad ldan pa la// sran ma'i bza' ba sbyin par bya// rlung gis rlung ni 'joms par byed// ji ltar me yis tshig pa la// me de nyid la bdug par bya// ji ltar rna bar chu zhugs pa// chu de nyid kyis dbyung bar bya// 'dod chags nyid kyis gdungs pa la// 'dod chags nyid kyis dbyung bar bya// bzlog pa sman du shes par bya// bzlog pa'i sgom pa 'di nyid ni// sangs rgyas mu stegs kyis mi shes// sangs rgyas pa'i lam gzhan dang gzhan du// rnam rtog dgag

/mi rtog pa sgrub byar 'dod/ nyon mongs la spang bya/ spong gnyen sogs gnyen po rnam pa bzhi blang byar 'dod/ 'dre 'dul/ lha bsten par 'dod/ sdug bsngal bsal/ byang sems tshol bar 'dod/ nad skyon/ nad med pa yon tan du 'dod/ 'khor ba bskyur/ myang 'das ni thob par 'dod/ mdor na mthun phyogs dang mi mthun phyogs gnyis su btags nas mthun phyogs la 'ong du re/ mi mthun phyogs byung gi dgos pas sdug bsngal las ma 'das/ 'dir gzhan spang byar byed pa thams cad bsgrub byar byed pas/ ngo bo chos brgyad mnyam pa nyid du mgo snyoms pa yin no// de'ang mi rtog pa bsgrub ma dgos te/ rnam rtog ngos zin pas mi rtog pa rang 'byung ba'i phyir dang*/ nyon mongs spang ma dgos te der zhen gyis ma bsnyad pas thabs su 'gyur bas dang*/ 'dre 'dul ma dgos te chos skyong du zhal sgyur bas dang*/ sdug bsngal bsal ma dgos te byang chub kyi sems skye ba'i rgyur 'gyur bas dang*/ nad skyon du mi blta ste sgrib sbyong gi thabs mchog tu 'char ba dang*/ 'khor ba mi spang ste 'chi rgyu zad pas so// mdor na tshad pa la drod btang*/ grang ba la bsil btang*/ lha 'dre la lha 'dre btang*/ mi gtsang ba la nyams grib btang*/ skyug bro ba la zhe log pa btang*/ nyam nga ba la bag tsha ba btang*/ 'jigs pa la skrag pa btang*/ re ba la dogs pa btang*/ mgo bo med pa la mjug med btang*/ btad pa dus med du btang*/ mtha' med la rlung khyer btang*/ bsod nams la lar zad btang*/ bzlog thabs ma nor bar bya'o/// / gsum pa la// nad 'don pa'i sngon du bla ma la gsol ba 'debs dgos par bstan/ bla mas ci gsung tshad mar 'dzin pa/ gnas lugs ngo sprad pa/ kun rdzob byang chub sems kyis gzhan gyi sdug bsngal dang du blang ba'o// dang po ni/ de ltar ston pa'i bla ma la// dad gus bskyed cing gsol ba btab/ yon tan thams cad bla ma la gsol ba btab pa las 'byung bas gsol ba gdab pa la ni thams cad du sbyar bar bya'o// gnyis pa ni/

de lta bu yi gdam ngag la// nges shes skyed cing nyams su blang*// ci mdzad gzhan don du go bas bla ma sangs rgyas su mthong*/ gang bstan gdam ngag tu go nas ci gsung tshad mar shes/ slob dpon thugs yid 'dres nas rang nyid tshad mar gyur pa ste/ tshad ma gsum gyis nyams su blang bar bya'o// gsum pa la/ nad glo bur bar ngo sbrad pa/ sgyu lus ngo sprad pa/ rnam rtog rtsa chad du ngo sprad pa/ sems chos skur ngo sprad pa'o// dang po ni/ glo bur ba yi nad gzhi la// rtag mdzin ma byed bor la zhog /nad glo bur ba ste mi rtag pa yin no// rtag par ma 'dzin/ de kar glod la gzhag go /des grol bar 'gyur ro// gnyis pa ni/ snying po med pa'i sgyu lus la// gces par ma gzung blo yis thong*// sgyu lus chu shing lta bur dpyad na snying po yid khar 'ong ba med do// gtsang bar mi 'dzin/ gces gces bor la gzhag go /gsum pa ni/ gzhi rtsa med pa'i rnam rtog la// dgag grub ma byed yal du chug /bdag gam bdag tu 'dzin pa'i rnam par rtog pa gzhi med rtsa bral yin no// bdag dang bdag gir mi gzung*/ dgag sgrub mi byed par 'jog go /bzhi pa ni/ spros dang bral ba'i sems nyid la// phan gnod med kyis blo bder sdod// chos thams cad sems snang yin la/ sems rang bzhin gyis ma grub pas// bden 'dzin bshig la gzhag go /bzhi pa ni/ bdag gi zhe 'dod bsgrub bya la// skad cig tsam yang mi bsam par// ji ltar byas la sems can gyi// sdug bsngal zhi 'gyur snyam du bsam/ de ltar lta bsgom spyod pa ci nyams su bstar yang rang don yid byed kyi bsams pas ma bslad par gzhan sdug bsngal las 'don pa'i don 'ba' zhig bsam pas spyad cing bsngo bar bya'o// gsum pa tha ma re dogs kyi 'phrang bsal ba la/ nad gdon ngos 'dzin/ nad la me btsa' btab pa/ dug bdud rtsir ngo sprod/ lha 'drer mi gzung ba'o// dang po ni/

gal te sos su re ba dang*// na yi dogs pa byung gyur na// nad gdon ngos ni zin pa ste// nad kyang de yin 'don yang de// nad sos su re/ na yi dogs pa ste/ re dogs gnyis po 'di kha nad/ 'di kha gdon yin/ 'di las gzhan du de gnyis ma grub ces pa'o// gnyis pa ni/ de nyid thog babs tshul du bzhag /de ka ngos bzung nas de rang gi steng du bcas bcos med par gzhag pa'o// gsum pa ni/ rnam rtog chos sku'i sprul pa ste// na ba chos sku'i 'phrin las yin// rnam par rtog pa thams cad chos sku'i thugs rje'i rtsal yin zhes pa'o// rnam rtog dbyings su yal ba la// 'chi ba zhes su btags pa yin// rnam par rtog pa dbyings su yal ba la 'chi ba zhes btags te// rnam rtog zad pa na 'khor ba thams cad shi ba zhes pa'i don no// de nyid gsal ba'i sgron me ste// de nyid drin can bla ma yin/ de bas na rkyen de nyid dge sbyor gsal 'debs pa'i sgron me// gdam ngag ston pa'i bla ma/ dngos grub ster ba'i yi dam/ byin gyis rlob pa'i mkha' 'gro/ bar chad sel ba'i chos skyong yin zhes pa'o// bzhi pa ni/ gnyen po dgag cing spang ba'i blo// skad cig tsam yang bskyed mi bya// 'di'i dam tshig tu/ gnyen pos spang bya mi spong ba ste/ rang bzhin shes par bya'o// gnyis pa 'bring dmigs pas 'don pa la/ gnyen po mkha' 'gro sde bzhi/ dmigs pa chos nyid skor gsum/ gegs sel gces pa'i man ngag /nad 'don dmigs pa'i rnam grangs/ gtum mo nyi zla drug skor/ ro snyoms bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ 'jigs pa med pa'i gdeng tshad las/ dang po la/ cha snyoms su bshad pa/ nad 'don du bshad pa/ gegs sel du bshad pa/ ro snyoms su bshad pa las/ dang po ni/ ngad can grang ba'i yul/ skam pa tshad gdungs che ba mkhris pa/ rlan can snum bad kan gyi yul/ 'dus pa ni 'dres pa/ rgas pa rlung*/ dar ma mkhris pa/ byis pa bad kan/

gzhon nu 'dus pa/ rlung chen dbyibs dgur/ sha skem/ mdog sngo/ smra ba mang*/ grang lhags mi bzod/ sgra dang bcas te 'gro/ nor chung*/ tshe thung*/ gnyid srab/ lus po chung*/ dmu rgod/ 'thab mo zla la dga'/ mdar skyur lan tshwa'i ror sred/ mkhris shas can skom dad dang bkres shas che/ skra lus ser/ blo rno/ nga rgyal/ rngul che/ dri nga*/ nor lus 'bring*/ mngar kha bska ba'i zas la sred/ bad kan can rang bzhin gyi lus gsal/ rus tshigs mi mngon/ sha rgyas/ kha dog dmar/ dbyibs dgye/ bkres pa dang skom dad chung*/ than pa bzod/ lus che/ tshe ring*/ nor dang*/ gnyid dang*/ zhe sdang che/ ngang ring*/ rang rgyud bzung*/ tsha skyur lga rtsub zas la sred/ ldan pa'am 'dus pa can ni de dag 'dres ma'o// rlung nad dbyar dus dgong dang tho rangs/ mkhris pa ston dus nyin gung mtshan gung*/ bad kan dpyid dus srod dang snga gro/ ldan 'dus can la so so'i dus de dang de ka ma tho ba tsam mo// da ni zas dang spyod lam gyi cha mnyam pa ston te/ rlung can gyi zas ni/ rta bong phyi ba/ sha skam/ sha chen/ 'bru mar lo mar ram/ bu ram/ sgog skya/ tsong*/ 'o ma zan chang*/ bur chang*/ lca ba dang ra mnye'i chang*/ rgun 'brum gyi chang ngo*// mkhris pa can la zas/ ba zho/ ra zho/ dar ba/ mar gsar/ ri dwags sha/ ra sha/ bkom sha ste ba lang gi sha gsar pa/ skyabs dang khur mang gi tshod ma'o// skom chab tsha/ chu bsil po// bskol grangs byas pa'o// bad kan can gyi zas/ lug g.yag gcan gzan nya'i sha/ sbrang rtsi/ skam sa'i 'bru rnying gi zan dron/ skom 'bri'i zho dar/ gar chang*/ chu bskol lo/ spyod lam ni/ rlung gi mis dro sar sdod cing dro bar bya// yid 'ong gi grogs bsten/ mkhris shas can gyi bsil sar bsil bar byas dal ba'o// bad kan can gyi dro sar dro bar bya/ rtsol bas bcag go /'dus pa la zas spyod lam de dag cha mnyam pa'o// 'og nas 'byung ba dag gi 'byung ba gang shas che ba de dgra dang sprad nas mnan/

chung na rang grogs dang sbyar te spar ba'o// gnyis pa ni/ dmigs pas 'don pa 'di lta ste/ chu ni me yis bskam par bya/ me ni chu yis gsad par bya/ rlung ni sa yin mnan par bya// sa ni rlung gis gtor bar bya/ snying ga chu'i gnas gyi gru gsum nang du me'i lha mo gos dkar mo dmar mo ye shes kyi me'i rang bzhin gri thod 'dzin pa gcer bu phyag rgya drug gis brgyan cing*/ nu ma dang bha ga rgyas pa/ bde ba'i nyams kyi gar stabs ling nge ba zhig gsal btab/ 'jig rten khams kyi drod sman thams cad mchod par phul mnyes/ grang ba'i nad thams cad zhi bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol zhes gsol ba btab pas/ sku las las kyi me'i zhun ma zangs lugs su rgyug kha ma lta bu tsha ba chi li li babs/ snying ga nas rkang pa'i mthil gyi bar du song*/ chu'i nus pa thams cad bskams/ grang ba'i nad thams cad bsregs te slar khengs pa spyi bo'i bar snod legs par gang ba lta bur bsam mo/ mgrin pa me'i gnas gyi gru gsum nang du chu'i lha mo mā ma kī dkar mo ye shes kyi chu'i rang bzhin gri thod 'dzin pa gcer bu phyag rgya drug gis brgyan cing*/ nu ma bha ga rgyas pa/ bde ba'i nyams kyi gar stabs ling nge ba zhig gsal btab/ bsil sman thams cad phul mnyes/ tshad pa'i nad thams cad zhi bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ sku las las kyi chu'i rgyun ga bur gyi khu ba lta bu bsil ba chi li li babs/ mgrin pa nas rkang mthil gyi bar song bas me'i nus pa thams cad bsad/ tshad pa'i nad thams cad sbyangs te slar khengs pas spyi bo khyab par bsam mo// spyi bo rlung gi gnas su sa'i lha mo spyan ma ser mo ye shes kyi sa'i rang bzhin gri thod 'dzin pa gcer bu phyag rgya drug gis brgyan cing nu ma dang bha ga rgyas pa/ bde ba'i nyams gyi gar stabs ling nge ba zhig gsal btab/ rlung sman thams cad phul mnyes/

rlung gi nad thams cad zhi bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol zhes gsol ba btab pas/ sku las las kyi sa'i bcud 'bri mar gyi zhun lta bur lci zhing snum pa chi li li babs/ spyi bo nas rkang mthil bar du song*/ rlung gi nus pa thams cad mnan/ rlung nad bsal/ khengs par bsam mo/ lte ba sa'i gnas kyi gru gsum nang du rlung gi lha mo sgron ma ljang khu ye shes kyi rlung gi rang bzhin gri thod 'dzin pa gcer bu phyag rgya drug gis brgyan cing*// nu ma dang bha ga rgyas pa/ bde ba'i nyams kyis gar stabs ling nge ba zhig gsal btab/ bad kan gyi sman thams cad phul mnyes/ bad kan gyi nad thams cad zhi bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol zhes gsol ba btab pas/ sku las las kyi rlung gi bcud margata gyi mtsho 'dra ba yang zhing g.yo ba chi li li babs/ lte ba nas rkang mthil tshun song*/ sa'i nus pa thams cad gtor/ bad kan zhi bar byas te/ spyi bo'i bar du khengs par bsams te/ thams cad kyi mthar stong pa nyid la gzhag go /gsum pa ni/ zad par sa dang*/ chu dang*/ me dang*/ rlung gi ting nge 'dzin sgom pa ste gzhan nas so// bzhi pa ni/ sa la lag pa'i sbyor ba lta bu'i las kyi phyag rgyas bskul ba'i byang chub kyi sems kun da lta bu de rnam par mi rtog pa'i ngang du sbyang snang ba'i lhan cig skyes pa stong pas ro mnyam pa zhes bya ba yin no// chu la yid kyi rig ma ye shes kyi phyag rgyas bskul ba'i dga' ba'i bde ba khams gsum gyi gzugs su spros pa ni stong pa'i lhan cig skyes pa snang bas ro mnyam pa zhes bya'o// me lha mtha' yas pa'i gzugs kyi phyag rgya chen mo la 'khyud pas rang rig pa ye shes kyi snang ba'i gzugs tsam de'ang rnam pa med pa zhi ba nyid du sbyang ba ni stong pa'i lhan cig skyes pa bde bas ro mnyam pa zhes bya'o// rlung la dam tshig gi phyag rgya la zhugs pa'i 'gyur ba thams cad zad pa'i snying rje stong pa nyid ris med par ldang ba ni bde ba'i lhan cig skyes pa stong pas ro mnyam pa zhes bya'o// gnyis pa ni/

stod nad thams cad/ ces pa ni tshad pa'i nad rigs rnams so/ gyen la/ zhes pa ni dmigs pas gtod pa'i yul te/ btsug tor gyi rtsa dbu ma'i sna'i rtsar/ bla ma'i sku rdo rje me long gi nang gi gzugs brnyan lta bu las bdud rtsi dkar sil chi li li 'bab pa zhig bsam pa'o// 'don/ zhes pa ni rang gi lus rked pa man rbad kyi chad par bltas te/ bdud rtsi des nad gdon thams cad dri ma'i rnam par nag ldur ldur 'og tu thon/ mthar lus je phra je phrar 'od du gyur te yar bar lta'o// smad nad thams cad/ grang ba'i nad thams cad do// thur la/ dbu ma'i mas gsang ba'i sna rtser bla ma'i thugs ye shes kyi me'i thig le mthing shun gyis bris pa lta bu las me 'bar bas lus kyi smad thams cad gang ba'o// bda'/ zhes pa de nas lus kyi lte ba yan rbad kyis bcad pa'i rtsa sbubs nas mes ded pas yar nad thams cad dud pa'i rnam par sngo 'phyur thon/ mthar lus mer gyur nas yal bar bsam mo// bar nad thams cad/ bad kan gyi nad thams cad do// thad kar/ snying ga'i sna rtser dbu ma'i dkyil du bla ma'i gsung rdo rje āḥyig dmar po las rlung gi bdud rtsi ljang gu 'phro ba'o// sang*/ zhes pa ni rang lus kyi khog pa thams cad lcags kyi khrol ma lta bur bsams te nad thams cad thal ba bus pa bzhin du bu ga rnams nas tshub ring ring thon/ mthar rlung gi rang bzhin du song nas yal bar blta'o// gsum pa ni/ log non rlung lnga gnas su gzhug /dang por srog 'dzin pa'i rlung skyon thams cad la snying gar mi shigs pa'i thig le 'od zer lnga pa la srog dang rnam par shes pa bsdus te bum pa can bya'o/ des sems brtan par byas pas mngon par shes pa drug thob cing chos kyi sku mngon du byed do/ me dang mnyam pa'i rlung gi skyon thams cad la lte ba'i mi shigs pa'i thig le 'od zer lnga pa la srog dang rnam shes thams cad bcings nas bum pa can byas pas der sems brtan pa na lha'i mchog las skyes pa'i bu mo la longs spyod cing sprul pa'i sku thob par byed do/

thur du sel pa'i skyon thams cad la gsang ba'i mi shigs pa'i thig le 'od zer lnga pa la/ srog dang rnam par shes pa thams cad bcings te bum pa can byas pas der sems brtan pa na rdo rje nor bur byang chub kyi sems 'ching bar 'gyur zhing bde ba chen po'i sku thob par byed do/ gyen rgyu'i skyon thams cad la mgrin pa'i mi shigs pa'i thig le 'od zer lnga pa la srog dang rnam shes thams cad bcings te bum pa can byas nas der sems brtan na bstan bcos thams cad rig cing longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku thob par byed do/ khyab byed kyi rlung skyon thams cad la spyi bor mi shigs pa'i thig le 'od zer lnga pa la srog dang rnam shes thams cad bcings nas bum pa can byas pas der sems brtan na lha'i tshogs mthong zhing kha sbyor yan lag bdun dang ldan pa'i ngo bo nyid kyi skur 'gyur ro/ 'di ni rlung de kho na nyid kyi gnas su rengs pa zhi bar byed pa'o/ yan lag rlung lnga rang sar gzhag /mig la sogs pa dbang po'i sgo so so'i rlung bskyon la de dang der srog dang rnam shes thams cad bsdus nas bum pa can byas pas sha'i mig lha'i mig sangs rgyas kyi spyan/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyan/ ye shes kyi spyan gyi bar dang*/ lha'i rna ba sogs dang*/ lha'i sna sogs dang*/ lha'i lce dang*/ lha'i lus la sogs pa nas ye shes kyi sku'i bar du 'gyur ro/ gnas de dang de'i rlung dbang po gzhan dang gzhan du 'gyur ba thob ste/ dbang po re res dbang po thams cad pa'i bya ba byed pa sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i bzhin no/ bzhi pa ni/ yan lag nying lag sprug cing 'don/ rtsa zug rnams ni seng ge rnam rol gyi 'khrul 'khor gyis rlung dgag pa'i mthar 'phag dang bstun rkang lag sprug cing rlung kha sna thams cad nas 'don pas bsal lo// gzer na bcal zhing dbyung bar bya/ zhes pa ni rlung zug sel ba ste/ 'og tu 'chus pa steng du bcol te sgregs pas 'don/

de bzhin gyen du 'chus pa dpyi zur bcal nas 'og sgor 'don pas so/ skrangs dang khol bur na ba la// 'khor lo lta bur bskor bar bya/ zhes pa thig le'i zug dbyung ste lus kyi gnas de dang de dag bskor zhing rlung dbyungs bas so/ yang na bcal zhing dbyung bar bya/ 'di ni rlung khams 'thor ba sdud pa ste/ lus brgyangs nas pho kha 'ba' zhig stegs cig la bkal gzhan ma regs pas/ brkyang bskum gyis bcal ba'i mthar rlung dbyung ci thub bya'o// skran gyi grong khyer me yis gzham/ skran gyis mtshon nas khong nad dag 'don par bzhed pa ste/ ma zhu ba rgyu/ 'bras bu gcong nad gsar snying gnyis gsar pa bad kan skya smyug mkhris pa dug nad bzhi/ rnying pa skran dmu 'or skya rbab/ zad byed rnam pa lnga/ grong khyer zhes mang ba'i dpes gsungs so/ thams cad kyang gang na ba'i sar bla ma me'i rang bzhin du bsgom/ des nad thams cad bsregs/ gang na sar bum pa can bzung nas bskor/ de nas dbyung*/ dmu chu rgya mtsho'i gting nas sprug /dmu chu la/ nad gdon dug las gyur pa gsum/ nad la byer zags 'khyil brdol ba bzhi'o/ mdor bsdu na tsha grang gnyis su 'du'o// thams cad la bum pa can bzung ste btsub shing lta bur bsgril ba gtsub pa/ khyad par lto ba'i rlung sprugs te seng ge rnam rol gyi 'khrul 'khor la 'bad pas chu thams cad bshal bar 'gyur ro/ smyo na ri bo'i 'og tu mnan/ smyo 'bog la sogs pa'i nad la rang gi snying gi lung thag de na ra ra byung nas bshang lam nas mar don/ sa'i 'og tu song*/ da ri rab kyis mnan par bsgom mo// mdze nad chu ser la sogs pa// kha sbu'i bu ga'i sbyor ba bya// mdze rigs bco brgyad la rang gi spyi bor rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje sems dpar bsgoms pa'i thugs kar zla ba la hūm̐ yig bskor ba gsal btab/ yig brgya gsol 'debs su bsams te bzlas pas sngags 'phreng las bdud rtsi babs/

zhabs g.yas pa'i mthe bong gi bar du 'ongs/ de nas don/ bdag gi lus kyi spyi bo nas zhugs rtsa'i nang thams cad du song bas nad thams cad dud khu gdon thams cad srin gyi gzugs ci yang dbang po'i sgo/ ba spu'i bu ga lhag par rkang pa'i mthe bong nas don par mos shing*/ lus nad sdig grib gdon gyis dag pas shel dkar po 'dra ba lus thams cad gang*/ bla ma 'od du zhu rang la bstim mo// sogs sgras rims kyis nad thams cad la/ snying ga'i 'od kyis 'dod pa khams kyi dbang mo 'khor bcas bkug sku 'od kyi mtshon cha dpag tu med pa dang bcas pa bdag gi snying la zhugs/ nad thams cad 'og gi sgo nas rlung rdo rje rgya gram tshun bdas/ spu gri can gyis rmeg med du bcom/ nad bdag rgyu ma'i nang du bkyigs nas// de la nad bdag mo thams cad bstim/ mtshon gyis gtubs/ sha rus khrag lhag ma med par zhal du gsol// mthar lha mo rang la gnyis su med par thim par bsam mo// lnga pa la/ bde ba gtso bor byed pa zla ba drug bskor/ drod gtso bor byed pa nyi ma drug skor/ bde drod cha mnyam du bsdom pa nyi zla drug skor las// dang po ni/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor a las ni// ga bur bsil ba'i chu rgyun dbab// 'di la lus gnad rnam snang chos bdun/ rlung gnad steng rlung brngubs lus thams cad gang*/ mi thub la khad na rdub chung btseg /de 'dra ba drug gi mthar dbyung ngo*// dmigs pa/ 'og steng phyogs bzhir zla ba'i dkyil 'khor as mtshan pa gsal btab pa dbyibs khang pa gru bzhi lta bu'o// nang du rang nyid lha stong rar gsal ba'i dbu ma'i yas sna mdzod spu/ de'i g.yas g.yon/ lce chung gi gnas/ mgrin pa'i rba rlabs dpung zur du 'khyogs 'tshams rnams su zla ba as mtshan pa re/ gsang ba 'khor lo drug gi mdud kyi dbu ma'i nang la zla ba ās mtshan pa'o// dang po steng gi zla ba dang a las bdud rtsi'i rgyun ga bur lta bur bsil ba babs/

de nas g.yas g.yon/ mdun/ rgyab/ 'og rnams las babs te gang snang tshun chu'i phung po grang ba'i regs pas khyags pa lta bur gyur par bsam/ de nas mdzod spu'i a las bdud rtsi babs/ g.yas g.yon/ lce chung gi dpung pa g.yas g.yon nas babs te lus thams cad khyags pa'i gong bu lta bur song*/ de nas mdzod spu nas 'khor lo mthar chags su 'dzag par bsam mo/ gnyis pa ni/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor raṃ las ni/ tsha zhing gdung ba'i me dpung spar/ 'di la lus gnad tsog pu thab mgal gyi phyag rgya can/ rlung gnad 'og nas bkang ste drag por 'byed 'dzum gyis 'then thebs drug gi ring stong rar khag de nas dbyung ngo*/ dmigs pa// phyi steng 'og phyogs bzhir nyi ma raṃ gyis mtshan pa drug gi khang par nang rang lha stong rar gsal ba'i rkang mthil/ dpyi gnyis/ drug mdo/ dbu ma'i mas sna drug la'ang nyi ma raṃ gyis mtshan pa re/ gsang ba 'khor lo drug gi nang gis dbus su nyi ma raṃ gyis mtshan pa'o// de nas 'og nas me 'bar/ rgyab/ mdun/ g.yon/ g.yas/ steng nas 'bar ba bskal pa'i me'i phung po lta bu mthong ba'i lam gyi mthar thug par 'bar/ rab tu 'bar/ kun tu 'bar bas dus kyis mtha' lta bu/ de nas lus kyi rkang pa g.yas/ g.yon/ dpyi g.yas/ g.yon/ drug mdo/ dbu ma'i mas sna nas me mched lus thams cad/ de nas gsang gnas nas rim pa bzhin 'khor lo drug tu 'bar bas me'i phung po gcig tu blta'o// gsum pa ni/ bla ma phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rnams// mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs pa la// gsol btab bdud rtsi zhu ba yis// gnyis med bcud kyis bdag lus dgang*// rlung gi dkyil 'khor yaṃ las ni// rtsol bsgrub drag po'i 'khrul 'khor bya// lus gnad gnyis po 'dam ka /rlung gnad steng mnan 'og bsdam/ rngub chung drug po la'ang steng rdub dus 'og kyang 'then no// dmigs pa/ phyi 'og tu yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor kham nag gzhu lta bu ba dan g.yo bas mtshan pa steng nyi ma logs bzhi'i 'og tu nyi ma bzhi/

steng du zla ba bzhi ste gyang rim gnyis pa lta bu'i khang pa thog zla ba/ de'i nang du nyi ma'i thad nyi ma/ zla ba'i thad zla ba sbubs can ga'u ga sbyar nang du rang lha stong rar gsal ba'i lus la sngar bzhin nyi ma drug dang*/ de re re'i 'og tu rlung gi dkyil 'khor drug sngar bzhin zla ba drug gsang ba'i 'khor lo drug la nyi zla kha sbyar thams cad sa bon gyis mtshan pa bsgoms te/ dang por 'og gi rlung gi dkyil 'khor g.yos nyi mar phog nyi ma las me 'bar/ de nas phyogs bzhi/ de'i nang gi nyi ma las me 'bar bas bar snang gi phyed man me dmar 'ur 'ur phas kyi byad kha thams cad gzhob tu'ang ma lus par sreg pa/ de nas steng gi zla ba las chu 'dzag phyogs bzhi/ de bzhin nang gi zla ba las chu 'dzag pa bar snang gi phyed yan chu'i phung por shig shig pa/ phas kyi byed ma thams cad grang ba'i reg pas rengs par byed pa/ de nas lus kyi rlung gi dkyil 'khor rnams g.yos nyi ma drug 'bar lus snying ga man mer dmar 'ur 'ur/ zla ba drug las chu 'dzag snying ga yan chus ltem ltem/ gsang ba'i 'khor lor 'bar 'dzag snyoms par 'jug pa'i bde ba'i sgras bla ma dang phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas sras bcas spyan drangs pa mos gus kyi 'od du zhu/ bdud rtsis na ba gso ba/ bcad pa 'byor ba/ 'chi ba slong ba/ ma dag pa'i lus ye shes kyi skur bsgyur ba/ gser 'gyur gyi rtsi lta bu sna dang mdzod spu nas zhugs te lus kyi nang dang gsang ba'i bdud rtsi dkar dmar ro gcig tu 'dres par bsgom na bsrung ba'i mchog bzlog pa'i dpyid/ grub pa na smad nas me 'bar/ stod nas chu 'bebs pa'i rdzu 'phrul ya ma zung ston nus shing mthar thug pa'i bar gyi yon tan kun 'byung ngo*// sgom pas dub na bca' ba lus kyi 'khrul 'khor rnams bya'o/ drug pa ni/ kun la bla ma'i rnal 'byor shis// ci dgu thams cad bla ma la// gsol ba btab las 'byung bar 'dug

/nad thams cad bla ma'i mos gus kyis 'don pa 'di la/ tshad par rang lhar gsal/ mgrin par ngo bo bla ma rnam pa chu shel gyi mchod rten snang tsam du yod la/ brtags na ngos gzung du med pa/ de las 'od 'phros/ rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma/ dkon mchog gsum gyi rang bzhin yi dam dang mkha' 'gro/ zhing skyong ba'i ḍā ki ma dang chos skyong thams cad bstim/ ro snyoms gsol 'debs byas/ sku las ye shes kyi 'od zer ga bur lta bu 'phros pas lus thams cad gang*/ tshad pa'i nad thams cad zhi/ lus ngag yid gsum sgyu ma tsam du sbyangs pas/ lha dang*/ sngags dang*/ ting nge 'dzin gyi rol mo sad pas bla ma nyid dang skal ba mnyam par blta'o// de bzhin grang ba'i nad la/ snying gar bla ma me shel gyi mchod rten/ bad kan gyi nad la lte bar gser gyi mchod rten/ 'dus pa'i nad la spyi bor rlung gi mchod rten bsgoms nas spro bsdu bya'o/ bdun pa ni/ sgyid lug zhum pa'i sems spangs la// snyoms las le lor mi bzhag par// seng ge lta bur spyad par bya// 'dis ni tshig gcig ma/ tshig bzhi ma/ tshig drug sbas pa mig 'byed rnams bshad de/ chos rje nyid kyi gsung las rgyas pas 'dir ma bris so// 'dis ni bye brag gi nad 'don thams cad kyang bstan par 'dod do/// / gsum pa ni/ bca' ba lus kyi 'khrul 'khor ni/ pad+ma lta bu'i skyil krung gis// thams cad mnye zhing steng gsum brgyad// mgo bo mnye zhing gyog pa dang*// lag pa bskor dang rgyab tu brdung*// lag pa gcud cing gnas drug bcing*// rgyab tu bkad cing mdun du bsdu// rgya mtsho sprug cig hab gyis rdeb// g.yas dang g.yon du bcu ba dang*// rgod pa'i lding thabs tshul gyis mchong*// rdo rje skyil krung la gnas te// ri bo bsgul zhing bya rkang gzugs// mthe bong 'then cing srin lag bsrang*// ka ra na yi sbyor ba bya// g.yas brkyang g.yon pa bcud la bor// g.yon brkyang g.yas pa bcud la bor// bya rmyang tshul gyis gan rkyal dang*// kha sbub g.yas g.yon mnyam pa dang*// sa ga sgyid pa'i nang phyogs nas// zlum po sgyid pa'i phyi phyogs nas/

rol pa rting pa sog khar gzhag /gzhan yang rgyug dang 'dur dang mchong*// g.yas dang g.yon du bskor ba dang*// mdun rgyab la sogs rdo rje'i gar// bla ma'i zhal las shes par bya// zhes bya ba dag ni phyag len gyis shes par bya'o/// / gnyis pa bye brag so so'i nad 'don ni 'di dag ste/ lha 'dre'i nad 'don ni mdze pho ro snyoms/ 'byung ba 'khrugs pa'i nad 'don ni 'byung chung ro snyams/ nyon mongs dug gsum gyi nad 'don ni bya spu gnam 'thor/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi nad 'don ni dgu phrugs ma dang*/ yul nyer bzhi'i nad 'don/ rnam rtog gi nad 'don ni bzlog sgom springs yig mas bstan te/ nad thams cad rnam par rtog par bsdus nas de mi spong bar lam du 'khyer bas rnam rtog lam khyer/ de nyid bzlog sgom gyi lam du byed pa nyon mongs/ dmigs pa rnon po'i lha sngags rig pa'i brtul zhugs bskyed pa lha 'dre/ nad byang chub kyi sems su sbyong pa sdug bsngal/ nad rang thog tu ro snyoms pa na tsha/ 'khor ba'i rdzun phugs bshig pas 'chi ba lam khyer du bzhag pa'o/// / gsum pa 'jug bsdu ba ni/ gzhi lta ba'i go cha/ rkyen bla ma'i mos gus/ dmigs pa rnon po'i mtshon cha gsum la sogs par bshad pa dag go// / bzhi pa phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i spyod pa la/ ngos gzung bas mdor bstan/ gtan la phab pas rgyas par bshad pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ brtul zhugs mtha' ru 'khyol pa dang*/ brtul zhugs kyi spyod pas rtag tu de kho na nyid la rtse gcig tu mnyam par 'jog nus pa nam thob pa'i tshe/ yang ni phyos las rnam rgyal brtsam// spang bya mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal bas dang*/ rang bzhin las 'da' ba med pa'i tshul gyis bgrod pa thams cad kyi mthar thug par byed pa'i spyod pa yin pas phyogs las rnam rgyal gyi spyod pa zhes bya ba de brtsam mo// saṃ puṭar/ grub par grags pa ma lus pa// zhes mdor bstan dang*/

byang chub la ni sems bzhag nas// phyogs las rnam rgyal brtsam par bya// zhes rgyas par bshad pas so/// / gnyis pa la/ dngos grub chen po'i nye rgyu/ dngos grub grub pa'i dus/ phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub dngos bshad pa'o// dang po ni/ dpal rnam par snang mdzad la sogs pa rigs gang gi tshul du 'tshang rgya bar 'dod pa des rigs rang gi phyag rgya blangs la/ me tog sogs pas mchod byas nas// bsam gtan gnas su legs 'dug ste// lhan cig spyod pa de dang gnyis gang 'dod pa'i lha'i rnam pa'i spro bsdu byed pa rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa'o// phyag rgyar lhan cig rab zhugs nas/ rdo rje'i sbyor ba yang dag brtsam// snyoms par zhugs pas thabs kyi rigs bdag gi khar thig le'i dwangs ma mngon du byas pa zla ba me long lta bu/ shes rab kyi rtsa mdzes pa'i spyi bor rak+ta'i dngas ma mngon du byas pa nyi ma mnyam pa nyid/ rtsa rlung sems bde ba thams cad ma 'dres pa yongs su rdzogs pa sor rtog gcig tu 'dres pa bya ba nan tan/ bzhi po yang dag pa'i mtha' chos nyid don gyi dbu ma der thim nas gtsug tor mchog grub pa'i tshe sgrib pa bag chags dang bcas pa ma lus pa gnas gyur pa'i sku dang ye shes thams cad mngon du mdzad pa chos dbyings te/ de ltar mngon par byang chub pa lnga'i rim pa 'dis ni phyag chen gyi dngos grub thob par 'gyur ro// de ltar saṃ pu ṭar/ thams cad mkhyen pas gang gang gi rigs kyi rab tu dbye ba las// phyag rgya gang dang gang gsungs pa// de dang de ni cho gas blang*// de dang de nyid kyis ni bsgrub// ces sogs dang*/ gur las/ de nas gzhan yang bshad bya ste// phyag rgya'i dos grub sgom pa ste// zhes sogs kyis so// 'dir ni mi mo'i phyag rgya bzung nas su zhes gsungs pa ni tso bor mdzad pa ste/ gzhan de nyid du/ rang rig mā ma kīr byas te// pad+mar rdo rje can bcug na// des ni dngos grub bcas 'gyur te// phyag rgya chen po 'di bsgrags so// zhes rang rig ye shes kyi rang gdangs/

rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong nyid de nyid yum du byas nas 'khyud pa las phyag chen gyi dngos grub 'grub par gsungs pas/ 'tshang rgya kha'i nye rgyur nges pa kho nar las rgya dgos pa'ang ma yin no// gur du/ de la 'khor lo rab phye ste// me tog spos kyi brgyan byas te// rdo rje'i gom pa rab rtsam mo/ zhes sogs gsungs la/ saṃ pu ṭar yang*/ rdo rje slob dpon dam tshig gi /grub rtags lag na rdo rje nyon// dang por 'khor lo chen po ni// snying ga yi ni dkyil 'khor du// der dri ma dang bral ba'i spangs pa dang*/ de kho na nyid mngon du gyur pa'i rtogs pa gnyis gang la gnyis su med par ldan pas dkyil 'khor du zhugs pa dang*/ rang gi dbang sogs ni chos thams cad rang gi ngang gis mngon par rdzogs par byang chub par mkhyen pas 'bras bu'i dbang rgyas par thob pa'o// rang gi nang du zhugs pa zhes pa de nas chos thams cad rnam pa thams cad du mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa ste rig ma'i skyes bu grub pa'i slob dpon chen po'i go 'phang thob pa bya'o/// / gnyis pa la/ tshe 'dir rig ma'i skyes bu grub tshul/ gzhan du 'chi ba lam du khyer ba ma bu ngo sprod pa'i gdam ngag bshad pa las/ dang po ni/ rdo rje nyi ma nub nas ni// sbyor ba 'di nyid rab bsams na// skya rengs shar ba'i dus su ni// 'grub par 'di la the tshom med/ srod la bdud bzhi bcom nas mtshan gyi thun tha rdzogs/ skya rengs ma shar tsam la dkar nag gi mtshams su mngon pa rdzogs par 'tshang rgya'o// nyin gnyis gsum bzhi lngas nges par// 'di ni gur las/ nyi ma gcig gis 'grub 'gyur ram// cho gas nyi ma gnyis na'am/ nyin gsum rab tu sbyor byas bsam/ de bzhin nyi ma bzhi yis sam// nyin lnga rab tu sbyar ba yi// 'grub par 'di la the tshom med// ces gang zag gi brtson pa'i stobs las gsungs la/ 'di ni rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i mtha'i spyod pa'i dbang du mdzad/

zhag bdun lha lta ba'i sbyor bas gnas par byas te/ bdun pa'i tho rangs 'tshang rgya ba ni bskyed pa'i rim pa'i mtha'i la dgongs zhes gsungs ngo*/// / gnyis pa la/ rab 'od gsal du 'pho ba mngon dga'i sa// 'bring sgyu lus su 'pho ba dus kyi sa/ tha ma bskyed rim la 'pho ba skye ba 'dzin pa'i sa gsum las/ dang po ni/ gal te 'pho rgyur rnal 'byor pa// 'chi ba zhes bya rnam rtog ste// dga' ba'i gnas su khrid pa'o// 'di ni khrag 'thung chen po'i brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa byed pa de la dgos pa ma yin/ zhi ba'i brtul zhugs spyod pa 'ga' zhig la ste/ tshe 'dir 'tshang rgya bar ma nus la/ 'od gsal gyi mes dngos por 'dzin pa thams cad bsregs par 'chi dus su bag chags mi 'jog des phra ba thim/ 'od gsal mngon du gyur ba'i rab tu dga' ba'i sa thob ste zung 'jug tu ldang ngo*// gnyis pas ni/ yang na bde ba can du skye// gal te rnal 'byor pas 'od gsal chos kyi sku mngon du ma byas kyang bdag byin gyis rlobs pas bar do gnyis pa'i dus su blo chod du grol te dag pa'i sgyu lus kyis bde ba can la sogs pa'i zhing mchog tu phyin nas 'phags pa'i sa thob par byed do// gsum pa ni/ gang 'dod rigs su'ang skye bar 'gyur/ sbyangs pa shin tu dman na bskyed pa'i rim pa bsdus te/ smon lam gyis mtsham sbyar te 'phos pas gang smon lam btab pa der skye bar 'gyur ro// gsum pa ni/ sdig pa kun las rnam grol zhing*// bsam pa thams cad rdzogs byed pa// gzung dang 'dzin pa'i sgom spangs phyir// phyogs kun rnam rgyal zhes byar brjod// rig ma'i skyes bu grub pa ni// gang du'ang mi 'gro/ gang du'ang mi gnas so// thog ma dang*/ mtha' ma dang*/ dbus dang bral ba/ gnyis su med pa/ gnas gsum du snang ba/ thams cad son pa/ thams cad mkhyen pa// thams cad pa/ thams cad kyi don thams cad/ sems can thams cad kyi sems la gnas pa/

sdig pa thams cad las rnam par grol pa/ yon tan thams cad kyis brgyan par byas pa/ thams cad dang ldan pa/ zhi ba/ mnyam pa med pa/ rtag par brjod pa/ mgon po/ skyob pa/ kun tu rtog pa spangs pa/ dbyibs dang kha dog bral ba/ rgyal ba'i yang spyod yul ma yin pa/ rgyal por phyed pa dka' ba'i phyir ro// nyon mongs pa'i gdung ba las nye bar grol ba'i phyir zla ba/ dogs pa med pa'i phyir seṅge/ gting dpag dka' ba'i phyir chu'i phung po/ de ltar dpe sna tshogs kyis rnal 'byor pa rnams kyi dpe bya'o// de nyid gcig pus sems can thams cad kyi don du rnam par rtog pa spangs kyang rmi lam lta bur sangs rgyas kyi rol mo mchog tu ston par mdzad do// gang du rig ma'i skyes bu grub pa der 'di lta bu'i phun sum tshogs pa 'byung ste/ sa 'di dag dga' zhing mgu la rangs pas rnam pa drug tu g.yos nas bdud kyi gnas su cha lang lta bu'i sgra grags pa dang*/ phyogs bcur bskal pa'i me lta bu'i skar mda' ltung ba dang*/ rgya mtsho chen po 'khrugs pa'i sgra dang*/ thams cad du gnam rdo ltung ba dang*/ de nyid du bskal pa me'i gzugs lta bu'i ye shes kyi snang ba 'bar ba dang*/ phyag rgya'i skye gnas kyi snying por khams thams cad snang ba/ khams gsum gyi sde brgyad thams cad der 'ongs nas yang dag par dga' bas bstod de legs so brjod cing*/ bsgrub par bya ba'i bsod nams kyi khams gsum du skyes pa'i mchod pa de rnams kyis mchod par byed do// dpal ldan nā ro pa chen po'i spyod pa chos kyi glu rdzogs so/// /bha ri rnal 'byor ma zhes bya ba ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro mas bsgyur zhing zhus pa/ chos kyi rjes mkhar chu'i brag nas gter du spyan drangs pa ji lta ba'o/// / rgyal byed tshal der rab byung lo/ 'di don 'byed do snyam sems nub// shin tu 'jigs bcas nam mkha' nas// gsang sngags ma rgyud tshig tu bshad// pha rgyud lam rim khrom du gtor/

gnyis med rgyud don thang mar brdal/ mkha' 'gros bka' chad cis mi 'byung*// zer rmis sad nas zla ba'i bar// gshol nas gsol btab rmi lam du/ sgyu ma'i gar bsgyur rje btsun gyis/ ring bsrel mang stsal mchod cig gsung*/ snang ba thob shes 'di sbyar ro/ e ma rdo rje tshig mtsho res// bshad pa'i chu klung bye ba phab// mos gus sgyur ba dpag mi nus// kun kyang 'o mtsho 'dir bdud rtsi/ rang sems dul ba'i snod kyis 'thungs/ de 'dra'i skal bzang 'jig rten gyis// nam mkha' ma lus khyab gyur nas/ rdo rje'i sa yang dog bgyid shog /'byung ba ro snyoms kyi legs par bshad pa zla 'od kyi bzung bas mchog tu bsngags par 'os pa'i gnas su gyur pa'i rnam bshad ku mu ta zhes bya ba/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen brag dmar ba chen po byams pa rab brtan gyis bskul ba'i ngor/ shākya'i lung rigs smra ba'i tshal du lhag par gzengs mtho ba'i puṇ+ḍa ri ka des sbyar ba thams cad kyang gsang sngags kyi spyod pa rlabs po ches skal ba dge bar gyur cig// /
